daily mean salinity

# initialize list to collect all outputs
all_sites_list <- list()
variables <- c("so", "thetao")#surface salinity and temperature


for (i in 1:nrow(stations_df)) {
  site_name <- stations_df$site[i]
  coords <- stations_df[i, c("lon", "lat"), drop = FALSE]
  raster_path <- stations_df$raster_path[i]
  
  site_data_long <- data.frame()  # To store long-format records per variable
  
  for (var in variables) {
    # Load the raster brick for the variable
    r_brick <- brick(raster_path, varname = var)
    layer_dates <- as.Date(gsub("X", "", names(r_brick)), format = "%Y.%m.%d")
    summer_indices <- which(months(layer_dates) %in% month.name[6:10])#june to october
    
    # Extract data
    extracted <- terra::extract(x = r_brick, y = coords)
    summer_data <- extracted[, summer_indices, drop = TRUE]  # Ensure it's a vector
    
    # Build a tidy (long format) data frame
    var_df <- data.frame(
      site = site_name,
      variable = var,
      date = layer_dates[summer_indices],
      value = as.numeric(summer_data)
    )
    
    site_data_long <- rbind(site_data_long, var_df)
  }
  
  all_sites_list[[i]] <- site_data_long
}

# Combine all into one tidy long-format data frame
final_output <- do.call(rbind, all_sites_list)

final_wide <- final_output %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(site, date),
    names_from = variable,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  arrange(site, date)

final_wide$site <- factor(final_wide$site, 
                          levels = c("WH", "SK", "BOK", "KB03", "SW08", "H21","BB23",
                                     "BB36", "GDY", "GB96","LL17", "IU7", "FIN"))

final_filtered <- final_wide %>%
  filter(format(date, "%Y") >= "2003",
         format(date, "%Y") <= "2023")%>%
  mutate(year = year(date))

final_mean <- final_filtered %>%
  mutate(year = year(date))%>%
  group_by(site, year)%>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(so))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'site'. You can override using the
## `.groups` argument.
my_colors2 <- c("#E37468","#D3906C","#E1C68C","#EBDB98","#D7E0B1","#BFCEB2","#99AEB7","#839CBA","#708EBF","#5E7FC2","#4666AB","#3A5696","#283C6B")

ggplot(final_mean, aes(x = year, y = Mean, group = site, color = site))+
  geom_line(linewidth = 1)+
  theme_light(base_size = 12)+
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors2)+
  ylab("Mean Salinity [PSU]") + xlab("Year")

#ggsave("Supplemental_Salinity.pdf", dpi = 300, width = 18.2, height = 10, units = "cm")

#extract surface salinity in sampling year + 5 years before

final_2023 <- final_wide %>%
  filter(format(date, "%Y") >= "2018",
         format(date, "%Y") <= "2023")%>%
  filter(site %in% c("BOK", "SW08", "H21", "BB23", "GDY", "LL17", "IU7"))

final_2022 <- final_wide %>%
  filter(format(date, "%Y") >= "2017",
         format(date, "%Y") <= "2022")%>%
  filter(site %in% c("WH", "SK", "KB03", "SW08", "BB36", "GB96"))

final_2018 <- final_wide %>%
  filter(format(date, "%Y") >= "2013",
         format(date, "%Y") <= "2018")%>%
  filter(site == "FIN")

final_5yrs <- dplyr::bind_rows(list("2023"= final_2023, "2022"=final_2022, "2018"=final_2018), .id = 'sampling_year')

  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors2)+
  stat_summary(fun = "mean",
               geom = "point",
               color = "black",
               alpha = 0.6)+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+

future salinity and habitat viability

use mean LS5 at 24 hours

this means that if salinity is below this threshold for a day, 5% of pop will die

survival contemporary is mean of all measured populations

adaptive survival contemporary is mean of best finish population

#these files are really big, skip below to load processed file directly
#load daily salinity data 
raster_path <- "cmems_mod_glo_phy_my_0.083deg_P1D-m_1769159187216.nc" #2020-2025

#process files
r_brick <- brick(raster_path, varname = "so")

r_df <- raster::as.data.frame(r_brick, xy = TRUE)

# Reshape the data to a long format
r_df_long <- r_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(x, y), names_to = "time", values_to = "salinity")

r_df_long$time <- as.Date(gsub("X", "", r_df_long$time), format="%Y.%m.%d")

r_df_long <- r_df_long %>%
  mutate(month = month(time))%>%
  mutate(day = day(time))%>%
  filter(month >= 6,
         month <= 10)%>%
  mutate(year = year(time))%>%
  filter(year != 2025)%>%#exclude 2025 since data was not complete
  group_by(x, y, month, day) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_salinity = mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

#try applying salinity change to daily measurements
#convert into sf objects and merge by nearest feature
diff_sf <- st_as_sf(
  r_df_diff,
  coords = c("x", "y"),
  crs = 4326
)

long_sf <- st_as_sf(
  r_df_long,
  coords = c("x", "y"),
  crs = 4326
)

long_with_diff <- st_join(
  long_sf,
  diff_sf,
  join = st_nearest_feature
)

nearest_id <- st_nearest_feature(long_sf, diff_sf)

distances <- st_distance(long_sf, diff_sf[nearest_id, ], by_element = TRUE)

summary(as.numeric(distances))

#nearest_join has some missasignments -->  remove 


df <- long_with_diff %>%
  mutate(
    x = sf::st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
    y = sf::st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]
  ) %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry()%>%
  dplyr::select(
    x, y,
    month, day,
    mean_salinity,
    salinity_diff)

df$future_sal <- df$mean_salinity + df$salinity_diff

df <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(salinity_diff))

#fwrite(df, "Daily_salinity_RCP85_BioOracle-Copernicus.csv")

r_df_days <- df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(x,y) %>%
  summarise(
    days_below_so = sum(mean_salinity < 5.0, na.rm = TRUE),#LS5 5.0 with glmer 24h
    days_below_so_fb = sum(mean_salinity < 1.7, na.rm = TRUE),#LS5  1.7 with glmer 24h (2.2 is upper CI)
    days_below_so_adj_95 = sum(future_sal < 5.0, na.rm = TRUE),
    days_below_so_adj_95fb = sum(future_sal < 1.7, na.rm = TRUE),
    days_total = sum(mean_salinity > -1, na.rm = TRUE),#-1 to include all possible days
    .groups = "drop")%>%
  filter(days_total == 153)%>%
  mutate(survival_so = (1-(days_below_so/days_total))*100)%>%#calculate percentages
  mutate(survival_adj_95 = (1-(days_below_so_adj_95/days_total))*100)%>%
  mutate(survival_so_fb = (1-(days_below_so_fb/days_total))*100)%>%
  mutate(survival_adj_95fb = (1-(days_below_so_adj_95fb/days_total))*100)

fwrite(r_df_days, "Habitat_suitability_RCP85_BioOracle-Copernicus.csv")

stations_df <- read.csv("Samples.csv", sep = ";")
coords.gps <- stations_df[c("lon", "lat")]


# get bathymetry data from NOAA using marmap 
bathydata = getNOAA.bathy(lon1 = min(stations_df$lon) -1,
                          lon2 = max(stations_df$lon)+1,
                          lat1 = min(stations_df$lat)-1,
                          lat2 = max(stations_df$lat) +1,
                          resolution = 2)

# min depth -1 stops them from crossing land

# correct coordinates if they can't find an ocean path
trans1 <- trans.mat(bathydata, min.depth = -1, max.depth = NULL)
lc_paths <- lc.dist(trans1, coords.gps, res = "path")
#GDY is on land here, correct
#SK is on land here, correct

coords.gps.corrected <- coords.gps
coords.gps.corrected$lon[stations_df$site == "GDY"] <- 18.6083
coords.gps.corrected$lat[stations_df$site == "GDY"] <- 54.5355
coords.gps.corrected$lon[stations_df$site == "SK"] <- 8.497694
coords.gps.corrected$lat[stations_df$site == "SK"] <- 54.059298
#54.5355, 18.6083, for GDY
#54.059298, 8.497694 for SK - moved out quite a bit for this one

lc_paths <- lc.dist(trans1, coords.gps.corrected, res = "path")

# Compute least-cost distances (km) matrix
lc_dist <- lc.dist(trans1, coords.gps.corrected, res = "dist")

save(lc_paths, file = "least_cost_paths.RData")
save(lc_dist, file = "least_cost_paths_dist.RData")

# simplify to "3e-29" style
sci_label <- function(x) {
  formatted <- formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 0)
  gsub("e\\+0*", "e+", gsub("e-0*", "e-", formatted))
}

df$label <- sci_label(df$value)
df$text_color <- ifelse(log10(df$value) > log10(1e-7), "grey30", "white")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    fill_value = ifelse(value == 0, NA, log10(value)),
    label = ifelse(value == 0, "", label)
  )

# plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = Target, y = Source, fill = log10(value))) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label, color = text_color), size = 2.8) +
  scale_color_identity() +  # use colors as-is without mapping to a scale
  scale_fill_viridis(
    name = "Connectivity",
    breaks = log10(c( 1e-12, 1e-10, 1e-8, 1e-6, 1e-4, 1e-2)),
    labels = c("1e-12", "1e-10", "1e-8", "1e-6", "1e-4", "1e-2"),
    na.value = "grey90"  # light grey for zero/NA cells
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(stations)) +
  labs(
    title = "Single-generational Connectivity",
    x = "Target Stations",
    y = "Source Stations"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0,
      face = ifelse(stations %in% bold_stations, "bold", "plain")

    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.key.height = unit(2, "cm"),
    legend.position = c("right"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

con.matrix <- con.matrix[-c(3:10,15,17,18,20,21,22,24:27),]

rownames(con.matrix) <- colnames(con.matrix) <- c("WH_22","SK_22", "KB03_22", "BOK_23", "SW08_22", "H21_23", "BB36_22",
                          "GDY_23", "GB96_22", "FIN_18")

con.matrix[, "SW08_23"] <- con.matrix[, "SW08_22"]


con_long<- as_tibble(con.matrix, rownames = "Indiv1") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Indiv1, names_to = "Indiv2", values_to = "connectivity")%>%
  mutate(pair = paste(pmin(Indiv1, Indiv2), pmax(Indiv1, Indiv2), sep = "_"))

con_max <- con_long %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  filter(Indiv1 != Indiv2) %>%
  mutate(pair_canon = paste(sort(c(Indiv1, Indiv2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
  group_by(pair_canon) %>%
  slice_max(connectivity, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  distinct(pair_canon, .keep_all = TRUE)%>%
  filter(connectivity > 0)

#load salinity dataset
env_5yrs <- read.csv("~/Documents/Experiments/Salinity/Popgen_stations/Environmentals_stations_recalc5yrs_6-10.csv")
pairs <- expand.grid(site1 = env_5yrs$site, site2 = env_5yrs$site, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

pairs$sal_diff <- abs(env_5yrs$Mean_sal[match(pairs$site1, env_5yrs$site)] -
                        env_5yrs$Mean_sal[match(pairs$site2, env_5yrs$site)])

# add pair label 
pairs$pair <- paste(pairs$site1, pairs$site2, sep = "_")

pairs_unique <- subset(pairs, site1 < site2)

pairs <- pairs %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    pair_canon = paste(sort(c(site1, site2)), collapse = "_")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  distinct(pair_canon, .keep_all = TRUE)

#load Baltic FST dataset
fst.matrix_b <- read.csv("~/Documents/Experiments/Popgen/fst-matrix_MAFgea_global.csv", header = TRUE)

row.names(fst.matrix_b) <- fst.matrix_b$fst
fst.matrix_b <- fst.matrix_b[-c(1)]

fst_long<- as_tibble(fst.matrix_b, rownames = "Indiv1") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Indiv1, names_to = "Indiv2", values_to = "fst")

fst_long <- fst_long %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    pair_canon = paste(sort(c(Indiv1, Indiv2)), collapse = "_")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  distinct(pair_canon, .keep_all = TRUE)

ibd_sal <- merge(fst_long, pairs, by="pair_canon")
ibd_baltic <- merge(ibd_sal, con_max, by = "pair_canon")#max con = strongest connection


dist_long$pair_canon <- dist_long$pair
ibd_baltic <- merge(ibd_baltic, dist_long, by = "pair_canon")

ID <- c(rep("C",2),"22", rep("C",2), rep("22",2),rep("C",3), rep("23",2), rep("C",2), "23", rep("C",8),
        rep("22",2), "C", "23", rep("C",2), "23", rep("C",2), "23", "22", rep("C",2))

ibd_baltic$ID <- ID
ibd_baltic$con_log <- log10(ibd_baltic$connectivity)


cor.test(ibd_baltic$fst, -ibd_baltic$con_log, method = "pearson")#0.25

## 0.2499885
